title: Localization isomorphisms for prescribed affine tensor cohomology lifts
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures, let C=A tensor_R B, and let i be an integer. Let S,T be functors from unbounded A-complexes to C-modules with natural B-linear restriction isomorphisms eS,eT to source and target [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. Assume that under these isomorphisms multiplication by a tensor 1 agrees with applying the corresponding cohomology functor to a times the identity of the complex. Let c:S to T be a C-linear natural transformation whose B-restriction, conjugated by eS,eT, is comparison. These are the coefficient-lift equations of [lem-pc-affine-tensor-cohomology-lifts]. Let qprime be a prime ideal of C; let q,pprime,p be its contractions to A,B,R. Let Rp,Aq,Bp,D be any models of localization of R,A,B,C at p,q,pprime,qprime respectively. The maps R to Aq and Bp are the composites through A and B, and the maps Rp to Aq and Bp extend them. The maps A to D and B to D are the composites of the tensor inclusions with C to D. The maps Aq to D and Bp to D extend these maps. Let f:Aq tensor_Rp Bp to D be a ring homomorphism whose restrictions to Aq and Bp are these structure maps. Let Sl,Tl be functors on Aq-complexes with natural Bp-linear restriction isomorphisms eSl,eTl to the local source and target. Assume the same Aq-generator equations and that a tensor-linear natural transformation cl:Sl to Tl restricts to the local comparison. Then S extended along C to D is naturally D-linearly isomorphic, via alpha, to Sl applied after termwise extension from A to Aq and then extended along f. The analogous isomorphism beta exists for T,Tl, and the square with c and cl commutes. Furthermore Tl extended along f is naturally D-linearly isomorphic to degree-i cohomology of the functorial Aq-K-flat resolution followed by termwise extension to D. This asserts localization compatibility of prescribed lifts, not existence of those lifts.

proof.text: Use the componentwise localization-square theorem. Its two naturality equations assemble alpha and beta with NatIso.ofComponents; NatTrans.ext turns its componentwise comparison into the required square. Apply coefficient-map flatness and the general flat target-extension theorem to Tl to obtain the final ordinary Aq-resolution cohomology identification. Combine the square and final isomorphism.
